task: SIDD-CC SRGB image denoising adaptation of Samsung Modular Neural ISP generic-lite NAFNet
dataset: MhdMohammadi/SIDD-CC SRGB train; 230 pairs from 115 scene instances across 10 physical scenes
split_unit: physical SIDD scene number (second token in scene-instance directory name)
note: sRGB-domain adaptation only; not raw-RGB Bayer ISP processing. SIDD-CC benchmark test blocks are evaluated separately and were not used in training.
reproducibility_note: Strict physical-scene split; validation scene group is disjoint from all training groups.
